speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I hear you have fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; these are concerning for a serious underlying condition. To begin my investigation, have you noticed any specific changes in your skin or stool, and do you have a history of smoking or recent travel?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss), abdominal pain, and specifically enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes is highly suggestive of this malignancy. While I have received your symptom report, I require objective confirmation through imaging and biopsy; therefore, I am requesting a CT Abdomen/Pelvis and a CT Chest to evaluate lymphadenopathy.
